protocol: Task AM observes all successful entries and actual exits of the original v1 pilot, including repeated entries of the same code. The comparison stop and holdout reservation remain in force.
Replay the exact original parameters, window and dataset. Require every recorded accounting counter and all lot counts, identifiers and statuses to reconcile before publishing the diagnostic result.

Emit only accounting counters and lot identifiers, formation dates, entry dates, scheduled exit dates, actual exit dates or null, audit end dates and closed/unresolved statuses. Every audit end date is the registered window end; a closed holding interval ends at its actual exit date. No return, NAV, price or terminal-mark summary, bootstrap, detection floor, ranking or comparison is reported.

Trace fields are observations only and never influence selection, eligibility, allocation, fills, marks or cash. No retrospective corporate-action adjustment, simulated cash recovery or successor conversion is added.

Lot intervals are retrospective v1 diagnostic obligations, not point-in-time instrument classifications or future corrected-simulator lots. Merger listing overlaps and pre-entry history identify matters to investigate; absence of a matching merger event cannot certify an interval free of corporate actions. A merger listing date is not a merger effective date.

Merge reviewed implementation and specification before execution in the isolated GCP research checkout under the established resource limits. Log a durable discovery start before loading the read-only spent panel; retain full logs and audit artifacts on GCP and return bounded accounting and coverage summaries only.

Do not modify collector databases, checkout, processes, schedules or credentials, read reserved pre-2019 prices, or extend the price window. Full candidate-pool and lookback classification, other corporate actions, successor lots, recovery and raw/adjusted quantity compatibility remain separate Task AG gates.
